stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 27.

As Marcos hugged Mom, he looked accusingly over her shoulder at Elena—the aroma of fresh cookies in the air whispered to him that his visit was no surprise.

What does the author’s use of personification emphasize?

options.label: F
options.text: Marcos realizes Mom has prepared in advance for his visit.

options.label: G
options.text: Mom understands what Marcos likes to eat.

options.label: H
options.text: Elena wishes that Marcos had not noticed the smell of the cookies.

options.label: J
options.text: Marcos feels welcomed by the smell of his favorite cookies.
